title: The heart is abelian
statement:
For a t-structure $(\mathcal T^{\le0},\mathcal T^{\ge0})$ on a triangulated
category, the heart $\mathcal T^{\le0}\cap\mathcal T^{\ge0}$ of
[def-weil-t-structure] is abelian. Consequently every idempotent of the heart
splits: an idempotent $e:A\to A$ of an abelian category splits as
$A\cong\ker(e)\oplus\ker(\operatorname{id}_A-e)$, with $e$ carried to the
projection onto the second summand.

(*Source: BBD, Théorème 1.3.6 and Proposition 1.2.4. The supplementary-kernel assertion is also Stacks Tag 0H9Q, homology-lemma-idempotent-splitting, for any preadditive category in which the two kernels exist; Tag 09SH gives the equivalent Karoubian splitting criterion.*)

proof.text: Equip the full subcategory t.heart.FullSubcategory with t.hasHeartFullSubcategory and apply the existing proved theorem CategoryTheory.Triangulated.TStructure.abelianHeart from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Triangulated.TStructure.Heart. This is exactly BBD Theorem 1.3.6 with no boundedness or nondegeneracy hypothesis. Its proof implements the original first four steps: extension closure and the split biproduct triangle make the heart additive; orthogonality gives negative shifted Hom vanishing; truncating a cone gives the admissibility triangle; the abelian-subcategory criterion then proves abelianity.

source.place: Théorème 1.3.6, abelianity proof, p. 31; Proposition 1.2.4 and 1.3.4

proof.text: In an abelian category let e be idempotent and g = 1-e. Prove g ≫ e = 0 and e ≫ g = 0. Define p = kernel.lift e g and q = kernel.lift g e, and write i = kernel.ι e and j = kernel.ι g. The kernel equation j ≫ (1-e) = 0 gives j ≫ e = j. Cancel the monic kernel inclusions to prove i ≫ p = 1, i ≫ q = 0, j ≫ p = 0, and j ≫ q = 1. Construct φ with hom biprod.lift p q and inv biprod.desc i j: the first inverse equation is g+e=1 and the second follows componentwise from the four identities. Finally biprod.desc i j ≫ e = biprod.snd ≫ j and j ≫ biprod.lift p q = biprod.inr, so associativity gives φ.inv ≫ e ≫ φ.hom = biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr.

source.place: Tag 0H9Q, lemma-idempotent-splitting, kernel case; explicit kernel universal-property calculation

lean.statement: theorem heart_abelian_and_idempotent_kernel_decomposition {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Preadditive C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [∀ (n : ℤ), (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C] (t : TStructure C) : Nonempty (Abelian t.heart.FullSubcategory) ∧ ∀ (D : Type u') [Category.{v'} D] [Abelian D] (A : D) (e : A ⟶ A), e ≫ e = e → ∃ φ : A ≅ (kernel e ⊞ kernel (𝟙 A - e)), φ.inv = biprod.desc (kernel.ι e) (kernel.ι (𝟙 A - e)) ∧ φ.inv ≫ e ≫ φ.hom = biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr
lean.note: The upstream abelianHeart and isIdempotentComplete_heart give the first clause and abstract splitting, but do not state the supplementary-kernel isomorphism with the specified projection. This theorem states all clauses together, reusing Mathlib heart, Abelian, kernel and biproduct.

blueprint_update.statement:
For a t-structure $(\mathcal T^{\le0},\mathcal T^{\ge0})$ on a triangulated
category, the heart $\mathcal T^{\le0}\cap\mathcal T^{\ge0}$ of
[def-weil-t-structure] is abelian. Consequently every idempotent of the heart
splits: an idempotent $e:A\to A$ of an abelian category splits as
$A\cong\ker(e)\oplus\ker(\operatorname{id}_A-e)$, with $e$ carried to the
projection onto the second summand.

proof.text:
For the heart defined in [def-weil-t-structure], the abelianity assertion is
the classical theorem of Beilinson, Bernstein and Deligne (Faisceaux
pervers, Théorème 1.3.6). Its only use below is that
the heart is idempotent complete: for an idempotent $e$ in an abelian
category the kernels $\ker(e)$ and $\ker(\operatorname{id}_A-e)$ are
supplementary subobjects of $A$, the map
$\ker(e)\oplus\ker(\operatorname{id}_A-e)\to A$ is an isomorphism
($\operatorname{id}_A=e+(\operatorname{id}_A-e)$, and the two kernels have
zero intersection), and under it $e$ becomes the projection onto the second
summand with the canonical maps of the split.
